errors.excerpt: Let $K$ be an arithmetic system with addition, multiplication, and zero. A subset $P\subset K$ is called a \emph{positive cone} if it satisfies: \begin{enumerate} \item if $a,b\in P$, then $a+b\in P$; \item if $a,b\in P$, then $ab\in P$; \item for every $a\in K$, exactly one of the following holds: \[ a\in P, \qquad a=0, \qquad -a\in P. \] \end{enumerate} The strict order associated to $P$ is \[ a<b \iff b-a\in P. \]
